protocol_contents.purpose: Mature FlashInfer TinyGEMM baseline coverage; no new mechanism, no natural quality or application speed claim

sampling.purpose: Caps 8/12/16 instrument actual B3/B2/B1; not natural EOS

timing.order: Random permutation and its exact reverse per block; resample blocks, not samples
timing.hardware: RTX5090, SM120, assert actual device name

qualification.coverage: First actual native graph state per full_A/full_B phase and B1/B2/B3, all48 layers, both TP ranks; not every generated step
qualification.cold_AA: Same tokens/APC hits and question/position sequence; first-state full tensor receipts bitwise
qualification.actual_graph_receipt: Instrumented FULL graph copies actual X/logits/selected IDs/normalized weights at gate/router boundaries; poison before first replay verifies complete overwrite
qualification.oracle: FP64 exact BF16 X/W matrix dot, all logits; finite/absolute/relativeL2/RMSE descriptive, no fitted threshold
qualification.relative_to_native: Full BF16 element errors/encoding-step differences plus IDs/weights changes
qualification.conservative_bitwise_drop_in_gate: Actual original gate/router recomputation matches captured graph; Tiny via same official router preserves ordered IDs and FP32 normalized weights bitwise for every row
qualification.gate_failure_meaning: Not qualified for direct replacement under this conservative contract; not proof TinyGEMM is mathematically incorrect or permanently ineligible
qualification.failure_policy: Retain all predeclared numerical checks. Any rank failing bitwise gate skips timing on BOTH ranks. Runtime/assertion/timeout retained separately; no tolerance change or retry
qualification.downstream_contract: Nonmonolithic MoERunner experts consume hidden states, topk IDs and weights only; assert no EPLB/fused gate/capture side effects
qualification.expected_native_layout: BF16 contiguous X[B,2048], W[128,2048], logits[B,128]; no bias, FusedTopKRouter softmax top8 renormalize

source_semantics.tinygemm_installed_dispatch: Official default STAGES16 if capacity permits else4; SM120 default4; no custom stage tuning
source_semantics.barrier_structure: Installed csrc has warp>=4 outer branch/elected inner lane and all-CTA syncthreads outside compute/DMA branches, matching FI2996 fix structure
source_semantics.vllm_gate_gap: SM120 excluded from specialized GateLinear and existing CuteDSL BF16 dispatch; actual per-layer eligibility asserted before experiment

measurement_limits: Two rank gate chains independent, no collective; not synchronous model step
Gate-only chain lacks attention/expert/TP cache interleaving
No extra output.copy_ because both original GateLinear and Tiny return retained GEMM output
No candidate installed in live model
Instrumented cap trajectories do not validate natural quality or JCT

CPU_validation.read_only_review: data agent checked actual opaque MoERunner call route, bindings, retained graph outputs and timing scope; poison-overwrite receipt added before freeze

scope: Existing TinyGEMM baseline conservative bitwise drop-in gate, not a new algorithm or task-quality/application-speed experiment.
